ipcert.acme.bad_nonce: Let’s Encrypt rejected the request nonce twice (badNonce).
ipcert.acme.bad_token: Let’s Encrypt sent a strange challenge token.
ipcert.acme.challenge: Let’s Encrypt couldn’t reach port 80 of this server or got a wrong answer ({detail}).
ipcert.acme.dir_no_neworder: Let’s Encrypt gave an unclear answer (no newOrder in the directory).
ipcert.acme.dir_not_json: Let’s Encrypt gave an unclear answer (the directory is not JSON).
ipcert.acme.limit: Let’s Encrypt is temporarily not issuing a certificate for this address (rate limit).
ipcert.acme.net: The server couldn’t reach Let’s Encrypt ({why}): check outgoing connections to port 443 at the hosting provider and try again in a few minutes.
ipcert.acme.no_account_url: Let’s Encrypt didn’t give the account’s address.
ipcert.acme.no_answer: Let’s Encrypt didn’t answer the request.
ipcert.acme.no_http01: Let’s Encrypt didn’t offer a port 80 check (http-01) for this address.
ipcert.acme.no_order_url: Let’s Encrypt didn’t give the order’s address.
ipcert.acme.not_cert: Let’s Encrypt sent something that is not a certificate.
ipcert.acme.not_json: Let’s Encrypt gave an unclear answer (not JSON).
ipcert.acme.poll_timeout: Let’s Encrypt didn’t finish the check in {sec} s — try again later.
ipcert.acme.profile: Let’s Encrypt didn’t accept the profile “{profile}” (a short-lived IP certificate): {detail}
ipcert.acme.server_during: Let’s Encrypt returned an error during “{during}” ({status}): {detail}
ipcert.acme.unclear: Let’s Encrypt gave an unclear answer.
ipcert.acme.unsupported: Let’s Encrypt doesn’t issue certificates for this address: {detail}
ipcert.cli.help: Let’s Encrypt certificate for the IP address
ipcert.cli.help_force: issue even if a valid one exists
ipcert.cli.help_remove: remove the certificate and the timer
ipcert.cli.help_staging: Let’s Encrypt staging (browsers don’t trust it)
ipcert.cli.needed_no: no (the panel isn’t open to the internet)
ipcert.cli.title: Let’s Encrypt IP certificate: {state}
ipcert.crypto.bad_account_key: The Let’s Encrypt account key can’t be read: {error}
ipcert.crypto.bad_sign: the openssl signature can’t be read
ipcert.err.challenge: Let’s Encrypt couldn’t reach port 80 of this server ({ip}). Most often port 80 is closed in the hosting provider’s firewall — open 80/tcp and try again. Kaskad keeps its own certificate for now.
ipcert.err.limit: Let’s Encrypt is temporarily not issuing a certificate for {ip} (rate limit). Kaskad keeps its own certificate for now.
ipcert.err.limit_when: Let’s Encrypt is temporarily not issuing a certificate for {ip} (rate limit): you can retry after {when}. Kaskad keeps its own certificate for now.
ipcert.err.no_cert_url: Let’s Encrypt didn’t give the certificate’s address.
ipcert.err.no_ip: The server’s public IP address is unknown — there is nothing to issue the certificate for.
ipcert.err.no_openssl: openssl is not installed on the server (apt install openssl): there is nothing to issue the certificate with.
ipcert.err.private: The address {ip} is not public: Let’s Encrypt issues certificates only for addresses reachable from the internet. Kaskad keeps its own certificate.
ipcert.err.profile: Let’s Encrypt didn’t issue a short-lived IP certificate (profile {profile}). Kaskad keeps its own certificate.
ipcert.err.unreadable: The certificate from Let’s Encrypt can’t be read: {error}
ipcert.err.wrong_ip: Let’s Encrypt issued a certificate that is not for {ip}.
ipcert.issued: Let’s Encrypt certificate for {ip} issued: valid for {lifetime}, renews itself.
ipcert.kept: The certificate for {ip} is valid for another {hours} h — not reissuing.
ipcert.log.issued: IPCERT: Let’s Encrypt certificate for {ip} issued (until {until}{staging})
ipcert.log.removed: IPCERT: IP certificate and renewal timer removed
ipcert.port80.busy: Port 80/tcp is in use: {who}. Let’s Encrypt checks the address only through port 80, and Kaskad doesn’t stop other services. Kaskad keeps its own certificate — the browser will warn once.
ipcert.port80.other: Port 80/tcp is taken by another program — Let’s Encrypt won’t be able to check the address. Kaskad doesn’t stop other services.
ipcert.progress.check_standalone: Let’s Encrypt is checking port 80 (a brief listener on port 80)
ipcert.progress.check_webroot: Let’s Encrypt is checking port 80 (through the site)
